headline: Vicariously hike the Appalachian in the gorgeous A Trail Tale
summary: Experience the Appalachian Trail virtually in the new game, A Trail Tale. This pixel-art game offers an immersive hiking adventure. Perfect for those who dream of thru-hiking but can't.

headline: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported
summary: Alt-right figure Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported to the UK. He was arrested by ICE for overstaying his US visa. Yiannopoulos failed to appear for an immigration hearing.

headline: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
summary: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic for copyright infringement. The lawsuit claims Anthropic used "tens of thousands" of copyrighted works. Companies seek up to $150,000 per work plus damages for stripped copyright data.

headline: Distraction-free writing gadget BYOK is adding custom extensions
summary: The BYOK gadget, designed for distraction-free writing, now supports custom extensions. This single-purpose device appeals to dedicated writers. It aims to help users focus on pure text creation.

headline: 4 Penny Coffins Lets You Play 19th-Century Detective – Or a 10-Foot Demon Ripping Friends in Half
summary: "4 Penny Coffins" is a new social investigation game set in 1888 Whitechapel. It blends "Among Us" mechanics with a Jack the Ripper theme. Play as a detective or a demon in 8-player and solo modes.

headline: The Pokémon Company on PokémonXP's Lottery System, Long Lines, and Limited Access to Workshops
summary: The Pokémon Company addresses concerns about PokémonXP. Issues include a controversial lottery system for access. Long lines and limited workshop availability are also being discussed.

headline: GTA 6 Will Have No Microtransactions or Generative AI at Launch, Rockstar Says
summary: Rockstar Games confirms GTA 6 will launch without microtransactions. The game will also not feature generative AI at release. This announcement comes ahead of its November launch.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream, Jurassic Park 4K Collection, Nintendo Switch 2, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming and tech deals. Featured offers include Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream. Find discounts on the Jurassic Park 4K Collection and rumored Nintendo Switch 2.

headline: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
summary: PC Harper's killers will remain in jail following new policy changes. The PM announced reforms to the early release scheme. Anyone convicted of manslaughter will now be excluded from early release.

headline: Burnham gets the early prison release changes he wanted - but at what cost?
summary: Andy Burnham secured changes to the early prison release scheme. The Prime Minister aims to keep hundreds more criminals incarcerated. Implementing these complex changes may come with significant costs.

headline: Church names pastor killed by falling sign at Christian festival
summary: A pastor has died after being hit by a falling sign at a Christian festival. Robert Guanco, 41, was identified as the deceased. He served as a pastor at Jesus the Living Water Church in Eastbourne.

headline: Three rescued, two still missing as French fishing vessel sinks in Channel
summary: A French fishing vessel sank in the Channel, with three crew rescued. Two crew members remain missing after the incident. The rescued individuals were taken to hospital.
